scheme_name: Madhya Pradesh Professional Talent Examination Award Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must have secured a first, second, or third position in PET, PPT or MCA entrance examinations conducted by the Professional Examination Board
Applicant must be pursuing technical and vocational subjects
benefits_summary: Monetary awards of ₹1,00,000 for first, ₹50,000 for second, and ₹25,000 for third positions.
documents_required: Hard copy of the prescribed application form
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
